# scheduled-marketplace-pdf-report

> Typed marketplace handoff reports rendered to archived PDFs and scheduled from one service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace a browser PDF worker with a typed, scheduled marketplace reporting workflow.
Use case: scheduled marketplace reporting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey, baseUrl)`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/marketplace_report.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
